cause: Tsulong copied native64 health/complements into signed32 day/night caches. DamageTaken captured health before the last damage,while the day cache was sampled on an earlier update before the last heal. A no-hit first transition could read an uninitialized cache.

Require the opposite current phase before consuming the action,so repeated/wrong-phase signals cannot invert twice. Initialize/reset the phase checkpoint. Preserve authored zero complement;do not invent a minimum HP or change victory thresholds.
